v1.kill_reason: The target is the upstream pdfplumber table-finding module, which is on PyPI (MIT) and in public git history, and is widely reproduced, so a frontier agent can plausibly recall much of it. Seal is weak because the oracle is installable. No dated public evidence shows partial agent success on this work, so the claimed 4 h band is unsupported. Rescue would require a materially different spec (new strategies or API, changed defaults) so the work is no longer recall of upstream code.

Band.why: No dated evidence; the algorithm is famous and likely recallable, so a frontier agent may reach the reference too easily. Capped low without evidence.

Build.why: Strip, hidden generator and oracle checks likely 2-4 days.

Fit.why: Pure Python, CPU only, small footprint; smoke build green offline.

Hor.why: About 700-900 lines in a 4 h tier is plausible but not clearly long-horizon.

Lic.why: MIT allows shipping the snapshot, data and reference.

Multi.why: Several strategies, settings, merge and cell stages give independent buckets.

Nov.why: Same subject as a public pdfplumber task (pdfplumber-stable, NL2Repo) with cosine 0.19 above the 0.15 bar; deliverable differs but subject overlaps.

Real.why: Real MIT project, tagged release, 10.8k stars, release dated 2026-06-15.

Ref.why: Complete permissive upstream module at a pinned release.

Seal.why: Oracle (pdfplumber) and reference are installable from PyPI and present in public git history; memory cannot be sealed.

Surf.why: 171 existing tests plus unlimited generated PDFs compared to a live oracle; large but the oracle is public.

spike_plan.kill_if: Recall-only build matches the oracle on most of the sample, meaning the task is recallable and too easy (K8).
spike_plan.pass_if: Recall-only build scores clearly below 0.5 of oracle matches on the sample, showing that memory alone is not enough.
steps: In a throwaway networked container, install pdfplumber==0.11.10 from PyPI as the oracle and confirm its version.
Confirm the tag commit matches the smoke commit 4c64b92; if not, use the tag commit for the snapshot.
Create a stripped copy with table.py, the table-related utils and the page table hooks removed; confirm the 6 stable head failures are excluded from grading.
Recall test: without opening upstream source, write a table finder from the stripped interface and spec alone, as a frontier agent would in one sitting.
Generate 20-30 PDFs (ruled grids, text-aligned tables, merged cells, skewed lines) and compare the recall-only output to the oracle on tables, bboxes and cell text.
Run the same sample twice to check determinism of the oracle output and of the comparison harness.
Score the recall-only build as a fraction of the oracle pass count.

v1.summary: The seed is real and MIT-licensed at a tagged pdfplumber release, with a ~700-line table.py that is verified at the tag, and the offline smoke build is green. It is killed as K8 because the reference and oracle are public and famous, so recall rather than engineering is likely to decide the outcome, and the claimed 4 h band has no dated evidence behind it.
